answers.core: Using a perceptually uniform color space like OKLCH is fundamental for high‑quality and accessible game visuals by modern standards, so OKLCH color support should become core and not stay an add‑on.
answers.workaround: I use my add‑on for OKLCH colors in Godot, but it's not a complete workaround because it cannot expand Godot's sRGB color gamut: https://codeberg.org/sosasees/godot-oklch-addon

title: Add an OKLCH color display mode
